title: ShopFrame
tagline: Farcaster Shopping frame for easy to find and buy products .
description:
The goal of this hackathon was to combine ecommerce and farcaster. It exposes product images, provides actions for product details and links to purchase. Ultimately, it can be integrated with crypto payment. Due to lack of time, this is still being implemented.
It is made based on open frames and can bring shopping product information and purchase specific product information. and it's integrated with dynamic.
how_its_made: it's built on open frames with typescript, next.js. using with coinbase onchainkit, frames.js, ethers, react-query, dynamic sdk to authenticate with normal users who want to buy with crypto. it's quite useful to debug with frames.js. but still need to improve more room and the frame is deployed to vercel.
